files.Title: SmartDock.AutoHideEdge
files.Summary: Edge of the dock root that holds auto-hidden panes.

files.Title: SmartDock.AutoHideEntry
files.Summary: One auto-hidden pane, plus the size used when it is pinned back or shown as a flyout.

files.Title: SmartDock.AutoHideHit
files.Summary: An auto-hide drop. is the strip, or the hot zone when the strip is collapsed.

files.Title: SmartDock.AutoHideLayout
files.Summary: Panes pinned to the four edges as auto-hide tabs.

files.Title: SmartDock.AutoHideStrip
files.Summary: One auto-hide strip in the same coordinates as the pointer. is an empty strip: the hit test uses instead of .

files.Title: SmartDock.AutoHideTargets
files.Summary: Picks an auto-hide edge while a tool pane is dragged. Documents and any float that is not tools-only are rejected by and get no target. A dock guide that contains the point wins, including a root-edge button that overlaps the hot zone. A floating window under the pointer wins as well, including where that window covers the zone: the drop stays a float dock, not an auto-hide. No allocations.

files.Title: SmartDock.DockActivePaneEventArgs
files.Summary: The active pane changed. Either id is null when there was, or is, no active pane.

files.Title: SmartDock.DockCaption
files.Summary: A caption bar the user drags. The default template paints the dock palette. A host replaces the look with an implicit or a new . Drag, double-click, and the window buttons stay on this control. A missing part is simply absent.

files.Title: SmartDock.DockCaptionRole
files.Summary: Which caption this bar is. The default template hides the title row on a strip caption.

files.Title: SmartDock.DockCommands
files.Summary: Commands a host can bind or rebind. Default keys live in and are read when the key is pressed, so replacing a gesture takes effect on the next key. Close is Ctrl+F4. Next and previous document are Ctrl+PageDown and Ctrl+PageUp. Float, auto-hide, save layout, and load layout have no default key.

files.Title: SmartDock.DockCompare
files.Summary: Structural equality for layouts. Doubles match exactly, which is what a JSON round-trip preserves.

files.Title: SmartDock.DockContentRegistry
files.Summary: Factories for the controls a layout reconnects by content id. calls a factory when it has no cached element for that id and reuses the element when the pane moves, floats, or the layout is loaded again. removes a factory so can install another.

files.Title: SmartDock.DockCustomTheme
files.Summary: Base class for a host theme. Subclass it and return the of a resource dictionary that holds Dock and DockMenu brush keys, such as Dock.Chrome and DockMenu.Panel. Assign an instance to . One dictionary can be shared by every window. The manager reads those keys from it and does not merge the dictionary.

files.Title: SmartDock.DockDragSession
files.Summary: Deterministic drag gesture. The WPF control feeds coordinates; tests call and with the same inputs and no mouse. A horizontal move inside the source strip moves the tab as soon as the pointer reaches a neighbor's midpoint. reports that reorder once. Leaving the strip floats the pane. A snapshot taken before the first change is what restores. A tool drop on an auto-hide strip hides the dragged pane, or every pane when the gesture is moving a tool-only float. and dock the whole window on a guide drop.

files.Title: SmartDock.DockDropPreview
files.Summary: The landing rectangle drawn while a drag is over a guide or an auto-hide edge. The default template fills Dock.Guide and draws no border. A host replaces the look with an implicit or a new . The rectangle itself is chosen in SmartDock.Core. The template only paints that rectangle.

files.Title: SmartDock.DockEdit
files.Summary: Mutates a . Every successful structural edit leaves a layout that accepts. Empty groups are removed and single-child splits collapse, except an empty tab group that a hidden entry still names. That group stays, with its weight, as a restore anchor. Proportions are weights. A side dock gives the incoming pane the supplied proportion of the anchor's area.

files.Title: SmartDock.DockEditResult
files.Summary: Result of a layout edit. Refusals such as "cannot close" do not throw.

files.Title: SmartDock.DockGesturePhase
files.Summary: Where a is in its gesture.

files.Title: SmartDock.DockGuideButton
files.Summary: One compass slot or root-edge button. The default template paints the dock palette. A host replaces the look with an implicit or a new . Hit testing stays on the guide rectangle in SmartDock.Core. The template paints inside this control.

files.Title: SmartDock.DockGuides
files.Summary: Hit testing for dock guides. A compass is centered on the leaf under the pointer. Four buttons sit at the midpoints of the host edges and dock against the root. A point that is not on a button is not a target. The preview is a separate rect from , not the button. No allocations.

files.Title: SmartDock.DockItem
files.Summary: Bindable pane properties for one item in or . A assigned to or targets this type. Its setters bind against the item, which is the . The manager reads these values when the item enters the source and again when they change. This element is not placed in the visual tree.

files.Title: SmartDock.DockKind
files.Summary: Document panes live in the document well. Tool panes are tool windows and may auto-hide.

files.Title: SmartDock.DockLayout
files.Summary: The whole dock: a main tree, floating windows, auto-hide bars, and hidden panes. The object is a plain tree. mutates it, saves it, and the WPF DockManager turns it into controls. It is safe to build on any thread, and it is not safe to mutate from two threads at once.

files.Title: SmartDock.DockLayoutException
files.Summary: Invalid layout data, or a layout JSON document this version cannot read. Editing methods return instead of throwing for ordinary refusals such as a missing pane or a disabled close.

files.Title: SmartDock.DockManager
files.Summary: Hosts a . Register content by id, assign , and the control builds the splits, tabs, floating windows, and auto-hide bars. Only the selected tab's content is in the tree. Drag a tab along its strip to reorder it, or off the strip to float it, then drop it on a guide to dock it. A tool, or a float of tools, can also drop on an auto-hide strip. Guides and the landing preview are drawn in a topmost overlay so the dragged window cannot cover them. Another float under the pointer shows that float's compass and edge guides; the topmost one wins, and the dragged window is skipped. A dock guide or that float wins where it overlaps an auto-hide hot zone. Documents are not an auto-hide target. The same gesture is covered by the internal drag methods, which call with coordinates and no mouse. Ctrl+Tab switches panes. closes, cycles document tabs, toggles float and auto-hide, and saves the layout. When is set and Windows animations are on, reordered tab headers slide and the dock guides fade. The auto-hide flyout is a child window so it paints above an pane. A click or focus inside that hosted window, including a child of it, activates the pane and leaves the click with the native window. The flyout opens and closes at its arranged size: a render transform does not move that HWND. Those clocks do not change layout, focus, or events. is the hit zone of a splitter, a flyout edge, and a float's border. applies splitter, flyout, and floating-window sizes live, once per frame, or as a preview on release.

files.Title: SmartDock.DockMru
files.Summary: Most-recently-activated pane order, and cycling of document tabs. Index 0 is the pane activated last. The order is runtime state. It is not written to layout JSON.

files.Title: SmartDock.DockNode
files.Summary: A node in the dock tree. Either a or a .

files.Title: SmartDock.DockPane
files.Summary: One piece of content in a layout. is the stable key an application uses to reconnect the pane to its control when a layout is restored. Ids are case-sensitive.

files.Title: SmartDock.DockPaneClosingEventArgs
files.Summary: A pane that is about to close. Set to keep it where it is.

files.Title: SmartDock.DockPaneEventArgs
files.Summary: A pane identified by .

files.Title: SmartDock.DockPaneState
files.Summary: Whether a pane is in the main tree, a floating window, an auto-hide strip, or hidden. The first three match . is a pane kept in , which is not a placement the host shows.

files.Title: SmartDock.DockPaneStateChange
files.Summary: One pane whose differs between two layouts.

files.Title: SmartDock.DockPaneStateEventArgs
files.Summary: A pane moved between the main tree, a floating window, an auto-hide strip, and the hidden list.

files.Title: SmartDock.DockPaneStates
files.Summary: Reads pane states from a and diffs two snapshots. The WPF host uses this where it raises layout notifications. Panes that exist only in the later snapshot are new, not a state change. Panes missing from the later snapshot are reported as removed. A pane in is , not removed.

files.Title: SmartDock.DockRect
files.Summary: A rectangle in the same coordinate space the host uses for pointer positions.

files.Title: SmartDock.DockResizeHit
files.Summary: Which edge of a floating window a pointer is on. is the client area.

files.Title: SmartDock.DockResizeMath
files.Summary: Grip thickness, splitter clamping, and floating-window edge tests. Sizes are device-independent pixels. The WPF host paints and applies the result.

files.Title: SmartDock.DockResizeMode
files.Summary: Whether a splitter, a flyout edge, or a floating window resizes during the drag or on release.

files.Title: SmartDock.DockSerializer
files.Summary: Compact versioned JSON. System.Text.Json source generation writes the tree directly, with no reflection and no extra package. Enums are lowercase strings and node kinds use a "type" discriminator ("split" or "tabs"). A document produced by deserializes to an equal layout, including ids, weights, selection, floating bounds and maximized state, auto-hide entries, hidden panes, toolbar bands, and empty tab groups that a hidden entry names. An empty tab group with no such entry is rejected. is omitted when it is null, so a document written before toolbars existed stays the same bytes. and a hidden entry's restore fields are omitted when they are the default, so a document with no hidden panes stays byte-for-byte the same. Unknown version numbers are rejected.

files.Title: SmartDock.DockSide
files.Summary: Where a pane is docked relative to an anchor node.

files.Title: SmartDock.DockTabHeader
files.Summary: One tab header. The default template paints the dock palette. A host replaces the look with an implicit or a new . Drag, select, and close stay on this control. A template that omits a part has no such button.

files.Title: SmartDock.DockTarget
files.Summary: A window that can receive a dock drop. is empty for the main host. A larger is painted above a smaller one. is the node edge guides dock against.

files.Title: SmartDock.DockTargets
files.Summary: Picks the dock window under a pointer. The topmost window that contains the point wins. The dragged window is skipped. No allocations.

files.Title: SmartDock.DockTheme
files.Summary: Dock colors. The static brushes are the dark palette and stay the instances they have always been. Chrome, floats, guides, the switcher, menus, and the toolbar dialogs paint with resource keys, so can replace those brushes and open windows repaint. is the opt-in menu and context menu. Nothing merges it on its own. is the scrollbar, tooltip, and focus visual. The dock manager, each float, the switcher, and the toolbar dialogs merge it themselves. A host merges another copy for bars outside the dock.

files.Title: SmartDock.DockThemeKind
files.Summary: Dark, light, or blue dock chrome. Dark is the default.

files.Title: SmartDock.DockToolBar
files.Summary: Attached properties for a placed in . A toolbar created from reads the same values from instead. identifies one button.

files.Title: SmartDock.DockToolBarCaption
files.Summary: Caption of a floating toolbar. PART_Grip drags and double-clicks to dock when visible; when the title is hidden, the grip collapses and the caption outside PART_Close is the drag handle. PART_Close hides the toolbar. PART_Title shows and trims it when the window is narrow. A trimmed title gets a tooltip with the full text. A vertical float hides the title and keeps that tooltip, because the button column is too narrow for it. A custom toolbar name is not drawn here; it is the tooltip. The close button is 22 DIP on a horizontal caption. On a vertical one it is a 32/3 DIP box (about 10.7) and its glyph is two thirds of the template's size, so a narrow column keeps a drag area beside it.

files.Title: SmartDock.DockToolBarCustomize
files.Summary: Chevron that opens the Add or Remove Buttons menu. The default template strokes Dock.Text.

files.Title: SmartDock.DockToolBarDrop
files.Summary: The line drawn while a toolbar is dragged over a band or an edge. The default template fills Dock.Accent. The control does not take the pointer.

files.Title: SmartDock.DockToolBarGrip
files.Summary: The grip drawn at the leading edge of a toolbar. Drag it to move the toolbar. Leaving the tray undocks it into a floating window while the button is still held. Double-click docks a floating toolbar back to the band it left. The default template paints three dots with Dock.Muted on Dock.Chrome.

files.Title: SmartDock.DockToolBarItem
files.Summary: Bindable properties for one toolbar in . A assigned to targets this type. Its setters bind against the item, which is the . The manager reads these values when the toolbar enters the source and again when they change. This element is not placed in the visual tree.

files.Title: SmartDock.DockToolBarTray
files.Summary: One edge of the dock that hosts toolbar bands. The template's PART_Bands panel receives one child per band. The default template fills Dock.Chrome.

files.Title: SmartDock.DockTree
files.Summary: Short constructors for a layout tree. The same tree can be built with object initializers or XAML.

files.Title: SmartDock.DragPointer
files.Summary: Reused pointer state for . Fill and in place so a drag move does not allocate those lists.

files.Title: SmartDock.DragStep
files.Summary: What a drag update did to the layout. Structure changes need a view rebuild; a follow only moves a window. means the dragged tab changed slots. The host redraws that strip and does not publish yet.

files.Title: SmartDock.DropGuide
files.Summary: A dock target. Root-edge buttons dock against the whole host; other buttons dock against one leaf.

files.Title: SmartDock.FloatWindow
files.Summary: A floating window. Coordinates are device-independent pixels.

files.Title: SmartDock.HiddenEntry
files.Summary: A pane took out of the tree, plus the place returns it to. Default place fields are omitted from JSON.

files.Title: SmartDock.LayoutMap
files.Summary: Resolves a layout to content ids. Pass the ids the application can create and the map reports which saved panes have no factory () and which factories the layout does not use (). Both of those lists are sorted. follows the visible tree: main, then floating windows, then auto-hide edges. Hidden panes are not listed. A known id that is only hidden is not unplaced. An unknown hidden id is missing.

files.Title: SmartDock.NodeBounds
files.Summary: Bounds of a leaf tab group, supplied by the view.

files.Title: SmartDock.PaneLocation
files.Summary: Where a pane currently lives. Group is null for auto-hidden panes.

files.Title: SmartDock.PanelPlacement
files.Summary: Where a pane sits after a layout is applied.

files.Title: SmartDock.PlacedPanel
files.Summary: A pane located by so a host can reattach content by .

files.Title: SmartDock.ScreenDip
files.Summary: A point in device-independent pixels (1/96 inch), the units stored on a .

files.Title: SmartDock.SplitChild
files.Summary: One cell of a .

files.Title: SmartDock.SplitNode
files.Summary: A resizable split. Proportions are positive weights, not required to sum to 1.

files.Title: SmartDock.SplitOrientation
files.Summary: Children of a horizontal split sit left to right. A vertical split stacks them top to bottom.

files.Title: SmartDock.TabGroupNode
files.Summary: A tabbed group of panes. The selected index is part of the saved layout.

files.Title: SmartDock.TabPlacement
files.Summary: Which edge of a tab group draws the tab strip.

files.Title: SmartDock.TabStrip.Header
files.Summary: One header along the strip. is the pane's index in its group. A negative index means this list is the whole group in order, and the list position is the model index.

files.Title: SmartDock.TabStrip.Range
files.Summary: Contiguous headers that fit in a strip. is the model index of the leftmost one. is true when at least one header is hidden.

files.Title: SmartDock.TabStrip
files.Summary: Header geometry for a tab strip, in the same coordinates as the pointer.

files.Title: SmartDock.ToolBarAlignment
files.Summary: Which end of a band a toolbar packs against. is the left of a horizontal band and the top of a vertical one. is the right of a horizontal band and the bottom of a vertical one. is the default and is omitted from JSON.

files.Title: SmartDock.ToolBarBandRect
files.Summary: Arranged bounds of one band. Bands on an edge are passed in band order.

files.Title: SmartDock.ToolBarBands
files.Summary: Hit testing and placement for toolbar bands. The host measures the trays and passes the rectangles. does not allocate.

files.Title: SmartDock.ToolBarBarRect
files.Summary: Arranged bounds of one docked toolbar, in the same coordinates as the pointer. PaneId and WindowId are empty for a main-window tray.

files.Title: SmartDock.ToolBarCustomizationChange
files.Summary: What changed in a toolbar or in its buttons.

files.Title: SmartDock.ToolBarCustomizationEventArgs
files.Summary: The toolbar and button a customization change refers to.

files.Title: SmartDock.ToolBarDrag
files.Summary: Along-axis offsets that open a gap while a toolbar button is dragged.

files.Title: SmartDock.ToolBarDrop
files.Summary: A drop target. tears the toolbar off. opens a new band and shifts bands at and after it. is the line to draw.

files.Title: SmartDock.ToolBarEdge
files.Summary: Which edge of the dock hosts a toolbar band. A floating toolbar keeps the edge it left.

files.Title: SmartDock.ToolBarEntry
files.Summary: Where one toolbar sits. , , , and stay the last docked place while is set, so a double-click can put it back. names the pane that hosts it. Both null is the main window. is an old floating-window edge; the dock moves that toolbar to the main window's top tray. Default values are omitted from JSON.

files.Title: SmartDock.ToolBarFloatMember
files.Summary: One toolbar inside a floating window, in the same coordinates as the pointer. Members of one window are visited in order by .

files.Title: SmartDock.ToolBarFloatWindow
files.Summary: One floating toolbar window. is , or the toolbar id when the window holds one toolbar. A larger is painted above a smaller one. stacks members top to bottom.

files.Title: SmartDock.ToolBarGridFit
files.Summary: One snapped size of a floating toolbar. and place every button. Horizontal fills a row and then the next. Vertical fills a column and then the next. and are the window: the cells plus the chrome given to , and at least that orientation's minimum width. is false when is at least , including a square.

files.Title: SmartDock.ToolBarItemEntry
files.Summary: One customized button. is the host's item key. is the toolbar whose collection owns the item; null means . Items with no entry stay in collection order on their own toolbar.

files.Title: SmartDock.ToolBarItemRef
files.Summary: An item as the host collection currently holds it.

files.Title: SmartDock.ToolBarItems
files.Summary: Ordering and visibility overlay for toolbar buttons. The host collection is not modified. An item with no entry stays on its own toolbar. A new item is inserted after the nearest preceding collection neighbor that is still on that toolbar. Unknown keys are ignored.

files.Title: SmartDock.ToolBarLayout
files.Summary: Toolbar bands and button customization stored with a . Null on the layout, and omitted from JSON, when the host has no toolbar state. A document written before toolbars existed has no toolBars object and still loads.

files.Title: SmartDock.ToolBarPackItem
files.Summary: One toolbar to place in a band. and are along the band.

files.Title: SmartDock.ToolBarSite
files.Summary: One place a toolbar can dock. An empty and is the main window. A pane id is that pane's content. A window id is a floating window's id. A window with a larger is painted above one with a smaller value. is the window that shows a pane: empty for the main window, else a floating window's id. is the open auto-hide flyout that shows this pane, caption included, painted above the other panes of that window. A point inside it selects this pane even when a smaller pane underneath contains the point. stays the pane's content, so the flyout's edges are where a docked pane's are. An empty cover is a pane that is not in a flyout.

files.Title: SmartDock.ToolBarSlot
files.Summary: One slot in a toolbar after the customization overlay is applied. Hidden slots stay in the list.

files.Title: SmartDock.ToolBarTrayRect
files.Summary: Arranged bounds of one edge tray.

files.Title: SmartDock.WorkAreas
files.Summary: Places a floating window that lies entirely outside every monitor onto the nearest work area. A window that intersects any work area is left where it is. Coordinates are device-independent pixels, the same space as bounds.
